deploy-bot: [staging] Deploy initiated for inference-runtime v2.4.0 by Alex Chen — tag: v2.4.0, commit: 3f7a9b28. changelist: kv-cache fix, batching perf tweaks.
Alex Chen: ack — will monitor smoke and dashboards.
Maria Gomez: quick Q — we holding any schema migrations for this wave?
deploy-bot: Smoke tests queued: smoke-suite-1 (ci/1887654321). estimated ~3m.
Samir Patel: I'll watch p50/p99 and GPU util. ping me on anomalies.
Jin Park: if reranker load spikes we should be ready to pin to previous tag v2.3.9. rollback playbook at /runbooks/rollback-inference.txt
deploy-bot: Smoke results: 12/12 checks passed. moving to canary traffic (10%). rollout id: roll/1887654321.
Alex Chen: 10% looks good from logs, no new stack traces. :thumbsup:
Maria Gomez: confirming: no schema migrations applied during this deploy.
Samir Patel: p99 is ~310ms (baseline 300ms). small blip but within tolerance.
Alex Chen: agreed. proceed to 50% after 15m if stable.
deploy-bot: Traffic shifted -> 50% at 1887654450. health: OK, errors ~0.5% (client timeouts).
Jin Park: those 500s look like client keepalive drops, not server regressions. continue.
deploy-bot: Rolling to 100% at 1887654520. initiating post-rollout smoke.
Samir Patel: watching async queues + GPU mem. no OOMs or queue backlog.
deploy-bot: Deploy complete — staging: inference-runtime:v2.4.0 deployed to all pods. duration ~5m. release notes: https://rwd.dev/releases/v2.4.0
Alex Chen: tagging release notes and adding short summary for tomorrow's change window.
Maria Gomez: thanks all. I'll prepare the change-window blurb if prod stay stable over next 24h.
Jin Park: reminder: if any regression, pin back to v2.3.9 and follow rollback playbook at /runbooks/rollback-inference.txt
Alex Chen: :rocket:
